column1: # Raid targets — which mobs the Raid Targets view (F31, ADR-022) lists.
# Hand-authored. One row per target: name, aliases (| separated), zone, group.
#   name     As THE LOG prints it on the slain line — the log is the authority
#            for matching, because that is the string a kill arrives as.
#   aliases  Other spellings of the same mob: the reference site's where it
#            differs (it drops the hyphen from Cazic-Thule and the title from
#            Innoruuk), so the door to the Bestiary still opens.
#   zone     Where it lives, as zones.tsv names the place — for the heading and
#            the door to the map. Where a KILL happened comes from the record.
#   group    The heading it is listed under.
# Matching is on the whole name under the article-stripped, case-folded key
# the Bestiary uses, so "a thunder spirit princess" is "Thunder Spirit
# Princess" and "Cleric of Innoruuk" is never Innoruuk.
# DRAFT (2026-09-20), awaiting the owner's review: built from the owner's own
# kill records in these zones plus names the reference index lists. Which
# named mobs count as raid targets on this server is the owner's call.
